items.exampleEn: Don't give up. You can do it!

items.exampleZh: 在下雨，所以我們今晚不出門。

items.exampleEn: I want to go back to Tainan someday.
items.exampleZh: 我希望有一天能回到台南。

items.exampleEn: The teacher told us to hurry up.
My aunt is looking for a new job.
Look at that big black dog!

items.sentenceEn: Can you help me look for my keys?

items.audioEn: I grew up on a farm, but now I live in the city.
items.audioZh: 我在農場長大，但現在住在城市裡。
items.questionZh: 說話的人小時候住在哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: I left my wallet at home, so I had to go back.
items.sentenceZh: 我把錢包忘在家裡，所以只好回去拿。

items.sentenceEn: Hurry up! The movie starts in five minutes.
items.sentenceZh: 快一點！電影再五分鐘就開始了。

items.stemEn: I tried to fix my old bike for two hours, but finally I ____.
items.stemZh: 我試著修我的舊腳踏車修了兩個小時，但最後還是放棄了。

items.stemEn: Please ____ the picture on the wall. Isn't it beautiful?
items.stemZh: 請看看牆上那幅畫，是不是很漂亮？

items.passageEn: Ben grew up in a small village by the sea. When he was twelve, his family moved to a big city. He felt nervous and missed his old friends. He often looked at photos of his village and wanted to go back. But he did not give up. He joined the school football team and soon had many new friends. Now he loves going out with them on weekends.
items.passageZh: Ben 在海邊的一個小村子長大。他十二歲時，全家搬到一個大城市。他覺得很緊張，也很想念老朋友。他常常看著村子的照片，很想回去。但他沒有放棄。他加入了學校的足球隊，很快就有了很多新朋友。現在他很喜歡週末和他們一起出去玩。

questions.questionZh: Ben 剛搬到城市時覺得怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 我們正在找一家便宜的旅館。
referenceEn: We are looking for a cheap hotel.
We're looking for a cheap hotel.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 are looking for 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 are trying to find、are searching for 等）也算對
「正在」用現在進行式（例如 are looking for、're trying to find 等）
「便宜的旅館」可寫，例如 a cheap hotel 等

items.promptZh: 我哥哥不想放棄他的夢想。
referenceEn: My brother doesn't want to give up his dream.
My older brother does not want to give up his dream.
My brother doesn't want to give his dream up.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 give up his dream、give his dream up、give up on his dream 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 abandon his dream 等）也算對
否定可寫，例如 doesn't want to、does not want to 等
「哥哥」可寫，例如 brother、older brother、big brother 等
